purpose: time-ordered sequential-break research split; never a random split

formation.use: label-quality inspection, baseline development, any learned calibration or reliability estimation

retrospective_challenge.use: locked retrospective challenge; no refitting or threshold selection from challenge outcomes

retrospective_stress.use: locked retrospective stress/transport check; heavily inspected historically and never described as fresh blind evidence

prospective_shadow.use: strongest future evidence; outcomes unknown at issuance

data_rule.formation_ny17: exact governed historical reconstruction under the same Twelve Data XAU/USD 1min 16:59 America/New_York semantics; no alternate daily substitute
data_rule.blocked_rows: fail closed; no interpolation, forward-fill or silent provider substitution

selection_rule.all thresholds_and_rule_choices_for_chal: must be determined from formation evidence or frozen literature/contracts only
selection_rule.2025_2026_seen_results: may diagnose failure modes but may not be used to claim unseen validation or to retune the locked challenge/stress result
